title: System Analyst - Power BI/Python/VBA/R
description:
**Job Description**
 At WSP, we're continuing to grow and develop our expertise in Earth and Environment, operating as a trusted advisor and technical expert on engineering design challenges for our clients across multiple industries. Our team is growing, and as a result we're adding a Data Scientist and Visualization Lead to our water quality group. As part of the team in Prairies and North, you'll be responsible for driving forward our ambitious plans to enhance our Earth and Environment service offering in the province through your work with a close\-knit team of engineering specialists, professionals, and technical staff.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 A day in the life…
   

  

* Day\-to\-day, you will work with the water quality team to expand and strengthen our data processing and visualization tools, with opportunities to collaborate with other environmental digitization and database teams within WSP;
* You’ll be part of a company wide initiative to grow our environmental digitization tools to become a market leader in the way that we visualize and analyze large environmental datasets;
* You’ll be proficient in python, VBA, R, and other coding languages, with the ability to interpret and update code from existing tools. You will troubleshoot/update tool functions with support from the technical team;
* You’ll be a leader and innovator in the development of Power BI dashboards used to visualize environmental data on mining projects throughout Canada;
* You’ll be working with a focus group who track water quality guideline updates in Canada, and you will support the team with managing these updates and issuing new versions of our data processing tools based on these guidelines;
* You’ll train and mentor our team in the use of our tools, and present learning opportunities to other groups to expand your professional network;
* Working closely with project teams, you’ll help identify new opportunities to expand the use of our water quality and environmental digitization tools, presenting to clients as needed, and helping troubleshoot and develop tools for project work.


**Qualifications**
 We'd love to hear from you if you have...
   

  

* A university degree in environmental sciences, computer science, or software development;
* Environmental data management experience and a related technical background is an asset;
* Effective communication skills with the ability to move projects forward independently, provide training to others on the team on tools, and seek out technical support when needed;
* A track record of using R, python, and VBA to develop data management, assessment, and visualization tools;
* Has a strong understanding of DAX, data modelling patterns and experience sharing reports with external users;
* Experience with ingesting and consolidating data from external sources using Power Quer;
* Are familiar with Microsoft Power Platform and can leverage the M365 environment for operational excellence;
* A desire to stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, machine learning, and data visualization.

title: Analyst
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Analyst role is a full\-time remote position responsible for supporting client projects with data\-driven insights and operational analysis. On a day\-to\-day basis, the Analyst will collect, organize, and analyze business data, prepare reports and dashboards, and identify trends to help clients improve efficiency and reduce costs. This role will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, document processes, and support the implementation of recommendations across areas such as recruitment support, virtual assistance, accounting, digital marketing, and IT solutions. The Analyst will also assist in defining performance metrics, monitoring outcomes, and communicating findings clearly to stakeholders in a concise, business\-focused manner.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including experience with data collection, interpretation, and reporting.
* Proficiency with productivity and analysis tools (e.g., Excel or Google Sheets, basic data visualization, and report\-building tools).
* Solid understanding of business operations, with exposure to areas such as recruitment support, accounting, digital marketing, or IT services.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a remote environment.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work in cross\-functional, multicultural teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Prior experience in an analyst, operations, or consulting role is beneficial; familiarity with offshore or outsourcing models is a plus.

title: Senior Economist, Management Consultancy
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Lead defined economic and data analytics workstreams across projects, ensuring outputs are delivered to agreed scope, quality standards and timelines.
* Apply economic appraisal, policy assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, demand and market analysis, and related analytical techniques to support advisory assignments.
* Analyse complex datasets using Excel, Python and other relevant tools to generate clear, evidence\-based insights.
* Translate technical analysis into concise, client\-ready reports, presentations, dashboards and recommendations.
* Interpret client requirements and work with project managers and technical leads to ensure deliverables respond to the brief and intended outcomes.
* Contribute to workshops, technical discussions and client interactions as required, bringing a clear point of view supported by evidence.
* Support proposal development, including methodology, technical approach, resourcing assumptions and relevant written content.
* Apply, or rapidly develop familiarity with, relevant Australian government and industry appraisal frameworks, including NSW Treasury and Transport for NSW guidance where applicable.
* Review own work rigorously, participate in peer reviews and ensure outputs meet WSP quality, commercial and risk management expectations.
* Provide guidance to junior colleagues, share technical knowledge and contribute to building economic and analytical capability within the India team.
* Comply with WSP policies, including SHEQ, information security, ethics and professional conduct requirements.
* Typically, 3–6 years’ experience in economics, infrastructure advisory, data analytics, policy analysis, transport economics, urban economics, public sector advisory or management consulting.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver project components with increasing autonomy, including structuring analysis, managing inputs, checking outputs and escalating risks when required.
* Strong quantitative and analytical capability, including experience working with large, complex datasets and drawing practical insights from imperfect information.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; working knowledge of Python, Power BI, R, SQL or other analytical and visualisation tools would be advantageous.
* Experience preparing written reports, presentations, charts, tables and other client\-facing material for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings, implications and uncertainties in plain language.
* Experience contributing to proposals, business cases, options analysis, economic appraisals, policy assessments or infrastructure advisory assignments.
* Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams and adapt to Australian client, project and governance requirements.
* Commercial awareness, professional judgement and ownership mindset appropriate for a senior consultant\-level role.
* Constructive, coachable and collaborative working style, with the maturity to seek feedback, act on it and support others.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Public Policy, Finance, Planning, Engineering, Mathematics or a related analytical discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Economics, Applied Economics, Data Analytics, Public Policy, Infrastructure, Transport Planning or a related field is desirable.
* Professional training or certification in data analytics, economic appraisal, business case development or infrastructure advisory would be advantageous.

description:
At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence and our ability to help our clients stay a step ahead of the competition. By hiring the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.
   

  

 NTT DATA, Inc. currently seeks a Service Desk Quality Analyst to join our team in India (Noida Location).
   

  

**Business problem to solve:**
 Audit transactions between Service Desk agents and End Users seeking technical assistance.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Position where the individual facilitates quality management system in specific teams under supervision. Performs periodic quality audits, quality controls. Runs quality reports and provides insights with analytical data. In Service Desks working in Hybrid/ Return to office model, performs monitoring of agent calls, with attention to customer experience and technical/functional excellence. Provides on\- going, on\-the\-floor support and facilitates development of agents' technical knowledge and customer interaction skills through conducting of targeted training/ educative programs and activities, continually raising the bar for quality and service levels. Collates and publishes metrics data related to quality management system for specific teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Conducts internal contact audits of Service Desk agents on determined channels on predefined audit criteria and form.
* Ensures findings are logged and tracked to closure.
* Coordinates with stakeholders such as the Service Desk Operations team, training etc. and provides inputs derived from audit results for agent and account performance improvement.
* Provides feedback to the agent periodically on performance and tracks progress.
* Generates status dashboard and ensures correctness on tools such as MS Excel/ Other.
* May perform ad\-hoc tasks and activities for projects initiated by stakeholders.
* Identify gaps in Quality of work delivered and implement/ recommend remediation.
* Makes amendments to tools, templates, and dashboards.
* Generates status dashboard and ensures correctness.
* May perform tools testing.


**Qualifications:** 
 1\-3 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and work experience. Language Requirements: Advanced English skills. Basic understanding of Infrastructure Services business process.
   

  

 Understanding of industry standards of customer service.
   

  

 Basic Knowledge of Audit process and possess analytical skills to utilize results.
   

  

 Understanding of ITIL concepts of Incident and Request management.
   

  

 Demonstrated basic Excel skills.

title: CONSULTANT- WATER ADVISORY
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking an experienced professional to work for water advisory role within our Earth \& Environment team, supporting design and infrastructure projects across diverse sectors. The successful candidate will drive initiatives that enhance, water conservation, and climate resilience, ensuring sustainable outcomes for large\-scale developments and infrastructure projects.
   

  

 As a consultant water advisory, you will collaborate with architects, engineers, and planners to embed water solutions throughout the project lifecycle, leveraging advanced modeling tools and global best practices.
   

  

 You will be joining a well\-respected, large and dynamic team with a wide range of clients across different markets and sectors including national and local government, industrial, commercial and scientific sectors.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Successful candidate must be able to demonstrate experience in:
   

  

* Water demand forecasting and data analysis.
* Water balance assessments and utility performance analysis.
* Basic hydraulic modelling using WaterGEMS, WaterCAD, EPANET, InfoWorks, or similar tools.
* GIS analysis and mapping (ArcGIS or QGIS).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and data management.
* Research, benchmarking, and data collection.
* Support development of water master plans and strategic studies.


 Optional experience in:
   

  

* Support NRW assessments.
* Assist in preparing business cases and investment plans.
* Power BI dashboard development and reporting.
* Contribute to governance and institutional development.
* Support proposal preparation, methodology writing, and report drafting.
* Experience in water quality assessment and/or monitoring


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering / water resources engineering.
* Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and project management skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, and decision\-making ability with flexible mindset
* Experience of working on multiple projects, simultaneously.
* Collaborative mindset and outcome driven working method.

* Ensure documentation remains current, accurate, compliant, and aligned with operational practices.
* Define review cycles, approval workflows, and document control standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of process documentation quality and usability.
* Establish standards for structured knowledge management and process repositories.
* Collaborate with process owners to simplify, standardize, and optimize documentation.

* Develop frameworks that make policies and procedures easily searchable, consumable, and reusable.
* Ensure process documentation is structured to support digital self\-service platforms, AI\-enabled knowledge systems, and agent\-assist capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and knowledge management technologies to improve user experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support the transformation toward self\-service and intelligent support models.
* Project \& Stakeholder Management
* Lead cross\-functional governance and process improvement initiatives.
* Develop project plans, governance forums, milestones, and implementation roadmaps.
* Facilitate alignment among global stakeholders, regional teams, business owners, and IT organizations.
* Track progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes across multiple initiatives.
* Provide regular reporting and executive\-level updates on governance maturity, data quality, and documentation health.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in Data Governance, Business Process Management, Shared Services, Operations Excellence, or related areas.

* Strong understanding of data quality management, governance frameworks, and process standardization.
* Experience defining policies, controls, workflows, and governance models.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS) organizations.
* Knowledge of ERP and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Oracle, People Soft, Workday, or similar systems.
* Experience with knowledge management platforms and self\-service solutions.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled knowledge management and digital transformation initiatives.
* Certification in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Data Governance, or Process Excellence is a plus.


**Success Measures**
* Improvement in data quality KPIs and governance compliance.
* Reduction in data inconsistencies across systems and regions.
* Percentage of policies and SOPs reviewed and updated on time.
* Increased adoption of standardized processes and governance controls.
* Enhanced self\-service effectiveness and knowledge base usability.
* Successful delivery of governance and process improvement projects.


 ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.

 Provide reporting and analytics support for advisor practices by managing regular reports, dashboards, scorecards, and data distribution. Collect, clean, reconcile, and validate data from approved sources such as CRM, pipeline, activity, and prospect tracking systems. Generate weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports, identify data quality issues and trends, and ensure reporting accuracy. Customize reports for advisors, teams, and leadership, create professional communications, maintain reporting templates and documentation, support automation and process improvements, and collaborate with leadership to enhance KPIs and reporting processes as business needs evolve.

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical Senior Business Analyst to support business reporting, operational effectiveness, and strategic decision\-making. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze data, maintain reporting processes, and deliver actionable insights that drive business outcomes.

 Partner with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Join our Team**
**About Opportunity**
 The role is accountable for identifying business insights and driving improvement opportunities through Statistical, Exploratory, and Advanced Analytics. The analyst will design, automate, and maintain analytical solutions across operational and network performance, enabling measurable on\-ground improvements. This role requires an analytical thinker who can translate complex datasets into meaningful insights for business and network functions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Reporting \& Data Analysis
   

  

* Extract, consolidate, and interpret operational and performance datasets to deliver meaningful insights.
* Lead the reporting and analytics approach within Operations by designing scalable, repeatable data pipelines.
* Create, automate, and maintain recurring dashboards and reports for stakeholders including senior leadership.


 Governance, Documentation \& Audit
   

  

* Maintain reporting calendars, SOPs, and process documentation.
* Develop and maintain governance and control documentation ensuring data integrity, audit readiness, and compliance.


 Process Improvement \& Ad\-hoc Analytical Work
   

  

* Lead the Global Benchmarking initiative for MSN, providing insights and executive ready narratives for senior SLOP and MSN leadership.
* Build and refine audit processes to enhance data accuracy and operational efficiency. Perform ad hoc and deep dive analysis to support evolving business requirements.
* Design and document new reporting solutions, including effort estimation and implementation planning.


 Exploratory \& Advanced Analytics
   

  

* Conduct advanced analytics on operational and network datasets to uncover patterns and improvement areas.
* Apply statistical and mathematical techniques to build insights that support network and operational decisions.
* Independently drive data led improvements and initiatives across processes.


**Essential Skills \& Competencies**
 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong understanding of Telecom or IT Service Operations. Applied Mathematics \& Statistics
* Advance Data exploration, storytelling, and strong communication skills.
* Familiarity with ITIL, eTOM, and TM Forum (ANO) process framework.
* 6 years of experience as Senior Data Analyst in Telecom/IT Service Operations.
* master’s degree in mathematics or Statistics (preferred).


 Good to Have
   

  

* Python knowledge for automation and analytical tooling.
* VBA experience for reporting automation. Hands\-on experience with Advanced Excel, Power BI, SAP BI, GCP, and Tableau.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* First 3 Months: Learn operational methods (domain knowledge), align with team culture, and begin contributing to data\-driven improvements.
* 6 Months: Improve analytical output quarter by quarter; deliver consistent, stakeholder\-ready insights.
* 12 Months: Independently explore data, generate insights, communicate findings, and manage customer interactions.

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-FSRM - Basel III Business Analyst _CSTC-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

 Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
   

  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators


 Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk\-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure\-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA\-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source\-to\-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation\-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high\-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit\-for\-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source\-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off\-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA\-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source\-to\-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source\-to\-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom\-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
* Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source\-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.
* Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit\-for\-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.
* Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.
* Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future\-state capital insights.
* Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.
* Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.
* Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.
* Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.
* Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source\-to\-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.
* Ability to understand exposure\-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off\-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA\-CCR, and operational risk.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive\-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.
* Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.
* Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.
* Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source\-to\-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.
* Familiarity with SA\-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.
* Certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, DAMA, or other relevant risk, data, or project delivery credentials.
* Hands\-on experience with project management, collaboration, and reporting tools such as MS Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Prior consulting experience or experience working with US banks, regional banks, global financial institutions, or regulatory\-driven change and remediation programs.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**About Our Company**
 Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
   

  

 Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Research Analyst will support the Alternative Investments and Manager Research teams by performing investment data analysis, due diligence support, reporting, and operational research activities across both private and liquid alternative investment offerings. The role will partner closely with investment analysts and portfolio research professionals to support ongoing manager monitoring, research projects, investment onboarding activities, and various reporting initiatives.
   

  

 This position provides broad exposure to alternative investments, manager research processes, and investment due diligence activities across multiple asset classes. The analyst will have the opportunity to develop investment knowledge while supporting a wide range of research, reporting, and analytical functions for both private and liquid alternative investment strategies.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Support quarterly and ongoing monitoring of alternative investment offerings by gathering, validating, and analyzing performance, asset, distribution, redemption, and portfolio\-level data.
   

  

 Prepare recurring research reports, dashboards, and analytical materials utilizing internal systems, FactSet, Morningstar, Preqin, Bloomberg, and other third\-party data sources.
   

  

 Assist with due diligence activities by reviewing offering documents, RFIs, marketing materials, and manager communications and extracting key information for analyst review.
   

  

 Coordinate and maintain investment research databases, due diligence records, SharePoint sites, and document repositories.
   

  

 Support manager onboarding, product review, and completion memo processes through data collection, drafting, and documentation.
   

  

 Assist with ad hoc analytical projects, including portfolio construction, holdings analyses, risk metrics, and other investment\-related research requests.
   

  

 Support recurring private alternatives reporting initiatives, including industry data gathering, performance benchmarking, and market intelligence reporting.
   

  

 Participate in manager meetings and introductory calls, documenting key discussion points and maintaining organized records of manager interactions.
   

  

 Coordinate the distribution, collection, and tracking of due diligence questionnaires, RFI responses, and related materials.
   

  

 Partner with investment research professionals across multiple manager research disciplines to support team initiatives and cross\-functional projects.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 5\+ years of relevant experience in investment research, due diligence, or alternative investments
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), preferably in Finance, Economics, Investments, or related field
   

  

 Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving capabilities
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 Active Series 7 license or ability to obtain within 120 days

 Prior experience conducting research on private markets (private equity, private credit, real assets)

 Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex investment concepts

 We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. title: Analyst - Customer Journey Mapping
description:
Join us as an "Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping”, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behaviour, and deliver content direct to users of information products. This role plays a key part in shaping a customer\-centric operating model by enabling clear visualisation of various customer journeys through robust mapping and process modelling techniques.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be part of a team responsible for mapping the end\-to\-end customer journey across the “awareness to advocacy” stages for Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking customers. This will involve bringing together customer data, insights, and operational process flows to identify opportunities that drive measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness, in alignment with Barclays’ transformation strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Information sourcing (through SME engagement and available documentation), and converting into detailed, integrated visual customer journey flows.
* Map journey flows at multiple (defined) levels of detail, ensuring all relevant journey variants are accurately captured.
* Gather key data points across multiple stages in the mapped journeys to generate actionable insights on customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Maintain journey map lineage through robust version control and periodic updates.
* Collaborate with other analysts to help establish linkages across journey maps and enable integrated multi\-journey views.
* Securing SME alignment on the mapped journeys.


**To be successful as an "Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Experience in process mapping and modelling experience, in Banking and financial services / Consulting / GCC.
* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design) and Blueworks Live (process mapping).
* Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with cross\-functional teams across multiple geographic locations to obtain relevant data references that support effective journey visualisation.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interpret and align banking terminology across Product, Fulfilment, and Servicing teams within customer journey maps.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Integrate multiple journey variant maps to provide a consolidated view of related customer journeys.


**Preferred Skills / Experience**
* Prior experience of working in / with:
+ agile transformation environments
+ Customer Experience / product teams

* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Celonis, and Power BI for workflow and performance optimisation.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Noida/Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Revenue Assurance Manager
description:
**Job Summary:** 




 The Revenue Assurance Manager is responsible for ensuring complete, accurate, and timely revenue recognition from Enterprise customers across all CPaaS products and services. The role acts as a bridge between Sales, Operations, Product, Billing, and Finance to prevent revenue leakage, validate commercial terms, reconcile usage with billing, improve billing accuracy, and strengthen revenue controls.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong analytical capabilities, experience in telecom/CPaaS billing systems, and a sound understanding of enterprise contracts, invoicing, collections, and financial controls.
 



**Key Responsibilities:**




**Revenue Assurance \& Billing**



* Ensure 100% revenue capture for all Enterprise CPaaS services.
* Monitor revenue leakage across SMS, Voice, WhatsApp Business, RCS, Email, OTP, and other communication channels.
* Validate customer usage records against invoices generated.
* Identify and resolve billing discrepancies before invoice generation.
* Ensure billing is completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Monitor unbilled and deferred revenue and ensure timely invoicing.



**Contract \& Commercial Validation** 



* Review customer contracts, purchase orders, and commercial approvals.
* Validate tariffs, discounts, credit limits, and billing frequencies.
* Ensure pricing in billing systems matches approved commercial agreements.
* Verify implementation of contract amendments and change requests.



**Revenue Reconciliation** 



* Reconcile:
* Carrier/vendor usage vs customer billing
* Platform usage vs invoices
* CRM/Sales Orders vs Billing System
* Revenue recognized vs collections
* Investigate revenue variances and recommend corrective actions.



**Enterprise Sales Support**



* Partner with Enterprise Sales teams during customer onboarding.
* Ensure all commercial documents are complete before activation.
* Support sales with revenue analysis and customer billing clarifications.
* Validate special pricing approvals and promotional offers.



**Financial Controls**



* Develop and maintain revenue assurance controls.
* Perform periodic audits of billing and revenue processes.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards (Ind AS 115 / IFRS 15 where applicable).
* Support statutory, internal, and customer audits.



**Reporting \& MIS**



* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly Revenue Assurance MIS.
* Publish dashboards covering:
* Revenue leakage
* Billing accuracy
* Unbilled revenue
* Credit note analysis
* Revenue realization
* Collection trends
* Present findings and recommendations to management.



**Automation \& Process Improvement**



* Drive automation in reconciliation and billing validation.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to improve billing systems.
* Implement controls to eliminate manual intervention.
* Identify process improvements to reduce billing disputes.



**Collections Coordination**



* Coordinate with Accounts Receivable for disputed invoices.
* Assist in resolving billing\-related customer escalations.
* Reduce revenue realization delays caused by billing issues.



  





**Experience**



* 5–10 years of experience in Revenue Assurance, Telecom Billing, Finance Operations, or Enterprise Finance.
* Minimum 3 years in the CPaaS, Telecom, SaaS, or Enterprise Technology industry.
* Experience with high\-volume enterprise billing environments is preferred.



  





**Technical Skills**



* Strong understanding of CPaaS products:
* A2P SMS
* OTP
* Voice
* WhatsApp Business API
* RCS Messaging
* Email APIs
* Push Notifications
* Knowledge of telecom billing and mediation systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel.
* SQL for data analysis (preferred).
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.).
* CRM platforms (Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, or equivalent).
* Power BI/Tableau for dashboarding.



  





**Core Competencies**



* Revenue Assurance
* Financial Controls
* Billing Management
* Revenue Recognition
* Commercial Acumen
* Analytical Thinking
* Process Automation
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk Assessment
* Data Analysis
* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills



**Preferred Industry Experience**



* CPaaS
* Telecom
* Cloud Communications
* SaaS
* Messaging Aggregators
* Enterprise Communications
* Digital Platforms



**Success Criteria (First 12 Months)**



* Achieve billing accuracy above
 **99\.9%** 
 .
* Reduce revenue leakage to
 **below 0\.10%** 
 of billed revenue.
* Eliminate manual billing exceptions through automation wherever feasible.
* Implement end\-to\-end reconciliation between CRM, CPaaS platform, billing system, and ERP.
* Publish standardized Revenue Assurance dashboards for management.
* Strengthen internal controls to ensure compliance with commercial approvals and revenue recognition policies.

title: Senior Product Business Analyst
description:
Hello,
 



  





 Please read line by line and Apply via email.
 



  





 Job Title: Senior Product Business Analyst (B2B SaaS)
 



 Type: Short\-term Contract
 



 Location: Remote
 



  





 We are building a complex B2B SaaS platform and are looking for a Senior Product Business Analyst who can translate high\-level ideas into structured, execution\-ready documentation.
 



 This role requires someone who can quickly understand verbally explained concepts, extract the underlying logic, and convert them into clear, detailed, and usable product documentation.
 



 You will work closely with the team through live discussions and working sessions. The ability to listen carefully, ask the right questions, and capture complete workflows with accuracy is critical.
 



 This is not a note\-taking role. You are expected to think critically, identify gaps, and help refine the system.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Convert high\-level concepts and verbally explained workflows into detailed functional specifications
 



 • Create end\-to\-end workflows including happy paths, edge cases, and exception handling
 



 • Develop clear workflow diagrams and process maps
 



 • Map complete user journeys across multiple touchpoints and lifecycle stages
 



 • Create low\-fidelity wireframes to clearly define screen layouts, user flows, key components, and functional requirements for designers and developers
 



 • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and dependencies across features and modules
 



 • Define role\-based access, permissions, and system behaviors (RBAC)
 



 • Define role\-based dashboards, including what each user type sees, key actions, and decision\-making views
 



 • Design and structure KPI\-driven dashboard components such as summary cards, activity metrics, and performance indicators aligned with product goals
 



 • Translate workflows into clear, trackable system outputs and measurable indicators
 



 • Ensure all features are aligned with visibility, reporting, and operational decision\-making needs
 



 • Exposure to AI\-assisted product features or automation\-driven systems is a plus
 



 • Ability to think in terms of scalable, automation\-ready workflows
 



 • Build structured data dictionaries and logical data models
 



 • Define system interactions and high\-level data flows between components
 



 • Identify automation rules, triggers, and system dependencies
 



 • Define key product metrics and ensure workflows align with measurable outcomes
 



 • Translate product flows into clear data capture and tracking requirements
 



 • Write detailed acceptance criteria for development teams
 



 • Break down features into structured, prioritized deliverables
 



 • Produce clear, structured documentation ready for designers and developers
 



 • Maintain and update all documentation in live shared documents
 



 • Support validation and testing by ensuring delivered features match documented requirements
 



  





  





 What We’re Looking For:
 



 • 7\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst
 



 • Strong background in B2B SaaS platforms
 



 • Proven experience documenting complex, multi\-module systems end\-to\-end
 



 • Strong system thinking with the ability to connect workflows across features
 



 • Strong experience translating product workflows into dashboards, reporting structures, and KPI\-driven views
 



 • Highly data\-driven mindset with the ability to define metrics and outcomes
 



 • Ability to work with minimal handholding and bring structure to ambiguity
 



 • Exceptional listening skills with the ability to quickly capture and structure verbally explained workflows
 



 • Strong critical thinking with the confidence to question, refine, and improve ideas
 



 • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written) — must be able to clearly articulate and document complex ideas
 



 • Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on clarity, completeness, and accuracy
 



  





 Important Notes:
 



 • This is not a UI/UX or coding role
 



 • Work will be driven through live discussions and collaborative working sessions
 



 • Speed with accuracy is critical — the ability to capture and structure complex ideas in real\-time is essential
 



  





 To Apply:
 



 Please send your resume to inderpreet@intoto.ca
 



  





 Thank you

This role will drive data\-driven decision\-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands\-on experience in AI\-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Noida
   

  

**Shift:** 
 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI \& Analytics Transformation**
* Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
* Design and deploy AI\-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
* Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
* Establish best practices and governance for AI\-assisted analytics and insight generation.


**Strategic Business Insights**
* Analyze end\-to\-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
* Perform root\-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision\-making.
* Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
* Deliver data\-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.


**Performance Intelligence \& Forecasting**
* Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
* Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
* Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
* Track week\-over\-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.


**Automated Monitoring \& Anomaly Detection**
* Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
* Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
* Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
* Lead diagnostic and root\-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.


**Optimization \& Executive Decision Support**
* Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
* Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
* Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
* Provide executive\-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision\-making.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
* Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
* Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
* Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.


 We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fair and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees or accept any payment from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Senior Analyst - Customer Journey Mapping
description:
Join us as a "Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behaviour, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. This role is responsible for supporting the design and delivery of end\-to\-end customer and colleague journey transformations across Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking front \& back\-office operations and will contribute significantly to shaping Target Operating Models (TOMs) and eliminating process debt.
   

  

 The role is also responsible for ensuring the consistency and quality of process maps developed by journey mapping analysts, and for translating those maps into a business\-relevant narrative for wider stakeholder engagement providing a cohesive storyline of customer and colleague pain points, while identifying opportunities to deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness, in alignment with Barclays’ transformation strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Journey \& Process Design**
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Support high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management
* Oversee Customer Journey mapping analyst’s output (timeliness and overall quality)
* Provide support to Analysts by providing best\-practice guidance and conceptual support on journey mapping techniques, as required
* Integrate multiple journey variant maps to provide a consolidated view of related customer journeys
* Coordinate with stakeholders to obtain relevant data references that support effective journey visualisation
* Develop insightful visualizations that highlight customer pain points and identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve journey efficiency.


**Tooling \& Visualization**
* Use Figma, and Blueworks Live to map current and future state journeys.
* Maintain a centralised journey register and ensure traceability to customer outcomes and control requirements.


**Transformation Delivery \& Governance**
* Identify automation opportunities across journeys leveraging RPA, and AI/ML models
* Support the delivery of transformation initiatives, including business case development, benefit tracking, and stakeholder reporting.
* Ensure alignment with BUK’s transformation governance, including floorwalk showcases.


**To be successful as a "** 
**Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:**
**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Experience in Target Operating Model design and customer\-centric transformation delivery in Banking and financial services / Consulting / Global capability centers.
* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design), Blueworks Live (process mapping) and MS Power point (presentation and storytelling)
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Drive high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate into actionable insights.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify pain points in the customer journey.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across global and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Skills**
- Prior experience of working in / with:

* agile transformation environments
* Customer Experience / product teams
* Familiarity with Design thinking concepts.
* Familiarity with automation and AI technologies (e.g. RPA \- UiPath / Celonis / BluePrism / Automation Anywhere, Salesforce \& Agentforce, CoPilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock GenAI).


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Noida/Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 Support the delivery of geospatial ecology services, including GIS, spatial data management, spatial modelling, and digital visualisation, to assist the Ecology and Environmental Approvals teams. Experience with Australian biodiversity mapping requirements is strongly favoured. The role contributes to the production of high\-quality geospatial outputs for national projects across the mining, energy, transport, and water sectors, applying spatial analysis and best practice techniques to support environmental impact assessments, regulatory approvals, and planning projects.
   

  

 Working closely with ecology and environmental approvals specialists, this role translates project requirements into effective spatial solutions, while maintaining data quality, consistency, and efficient workflows. The role also contributes to continuous improvement and innovation in geospatial processes, supporting the growth of geospatial ecology capability through strong technical delivery and collaboration across national teams and the broader WSP network.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver geospatial ecology services, including GIS analysis, spatial data management, spatial modelling, and digital visualisation to support ecology and environmental approvals projects.
* Contribute to national projects across the mining, energy, transport, and water sectors, ensuring high\-quality and consistent spatial outputs.
* Apply established spatial analysis methods and support the development of best practice approaches in environmental assessment and planning.
* Collaborate with ecology and environmental approvals teams to understand project requirements and develop effective spatial solutions.
* Prepare, manage, and maintain spatial datasets, ensuring data quality, accuracy, and compliance with project and organisational standards.
* Support client deliverables, including mapping, spatial analysis, and reporting, with a focus on clear communication of spatial information.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of geospatial workflows, tools, and processes.

 The resource will work closely with different Business Units to understand their offerings, audiences, markets, priorities, and growth objectives, and translate those business goals into structured

description:
**Req ID:** 
 386632
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a NetReveal Technical Lead to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 NetReveal Technical Lead
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced NetReveal Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation of a high\-volume Transaction Monitoring migration.
   

  

 The role will own the NetReveal technical workstream, including historical data loading, profile generation, scenario execution, batch optimisation and technical readiness. The successful candidate will provide hands\-on leadership to the development team and work closely with Product Owner, Data, Financial Crime, Testing, Architecture and Governance stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the end\-to\-end NetReveal technical workstream including interlocks with wider migration programme.
   

  

 Assess the existing NetReveal implementation, processing model, batch schedules and technical constraints.
   

  

 Define the technical approach for loading historical customer, account and transaction data.
   

  

 Design an efficient approach for loading data at scale and reduce the existing method from 20 to 30 days to 5 or 10 days.
   

  

 Define the strategy for customer profile creation, rebuild and reprofiling.
   

  

 Ensure sufficient transaction history is available to support scenario look\-back periods.
   

  

 Evaluate alternative approaches to historical transaction and sequential batch processing.
   

  

 Lead the technical implementation of customer segmentation requirements.
   

  

 Agree the design and lead implementation of a process for customer matching and merging between TSB and Santander records.
   

  

 Assess the impact of the migration on existing NetReveal scenarios, profiles and processing windows.
   

  

 Lead performance tuning, batch optimisation and technical problem resolution.
   

  

 Provide technical direction to NetReveal developers.
   

  

 Review technical designs, code, configuration and deployment artefacts.
   

  

 Work with the Test Lead to define technically representative test scenarios.
   

  

 Agree data controls and certification approach.
   

  

 Produce technical documentation and evidence for design, risk and governance approval.
   

  

 Support cutover planning, implementation, reconciliation and post\-migration assurance.
   

  

**Essential Experience**
 Extensive hands\-on experience implementing or enhancing SymphonyAI NetReveal version 8 or later (version 9 preferred).
   

  

 Strong experience with the Transaction Monitoring SMBD engine using Spark; experience limited to the classic NetReveal TM engine will not be sufficient.
   

  

 Strong understanding of NetReveal data structures, profiling, segmentation, scenarios and batch processing.
   

  

 Experience with customer profile generation, large\-scale reprofiling and migration using the TM SMBD Spark engine.
   

  

 Experience loading significant volumes of historical transaction data into NetReveal.
   

  

 Experience using and analysing Parquet files generated by the TM SMBD Spark engine for profile validation and migration activities.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AML Transaction Monitoring concepts.
   

  

 Experience with scenario look\-back periods, behavioural monitoring and customer segmentation.
   

  

 Strong SQL and data analysis capability.
   

  

 Experience diagnosing performance issues and optimising batch processing.
   

  

 Experience working within a highly governed banking environment.
   

  

 Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining sufficiently hands\-on.

**DR and Ops Management Support Specialist \| IT \| Global Technology** 




  





  





**Qualification** 




  




* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Disaster Recovery, IT operations support, reporting, or service onboarding functions
* Strong understanding of Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity processes, including planning, annual testing, tracking, and remediation follow\-up
* Working knowledge of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery frameworks and concepts (RTO/RPO, Business Impact Analysis, failover/failback procedures, backup and replication strategies)
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, particularly advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis) for management reporting and tracking
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Automate to build and maintain workflow automations for recurring tasks, approvals, and notifications
* Experience supporting operational reporting and management dashboards using visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI (highly desirable), Tableau, and Qlik Sense
* Working knowledge of infrastructure, database, desktop, and end\-user support operations
* Experience coordinating application onboarding / take\-on (ATO) activities, including documentation, cost, resource, and support readiness assessments
* Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar for incident, change, and problem management
* Working knowledge of cloud\-based DR concepts (AWS/Azure DR, backup, and recovery services) is a plus
* Basic scripting/query skills (e.g., SQL, Power Query, VBA, or similar) to automate recurring reports and reduce manual effort
* Strong analytical and technical problem\-solving skills and Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable engaging both technical and business stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting status, risks, and recommendations to leadership
* Experience with at least one ticketing or workflow management system
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent initiatives (DR tests, onboarding, reporting cycles) with minimal supervision, in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to work collaboratively across geographically distributed teams



  





**Responsibility** 




  




* Coordinate with Application Technical Owners to ensure Disaster Recovery solutions are documented, maintained, tested, and aligned to business continuity requirements. Plan and support DR annual test exercises for critical business processes; track issues and lessons learned, and ensure follow\-up actions are completed
* Maintain execution plans for DR procedures and understand interdependencies across systems and teams. Track and report DR test outcomes, remediation status, and risk exposure to leadership and audit/compliance stakeholders as required
* Support service onboarding and application take\-on (ATO) processes by coordinating assessments of documentation, cost, resources, and service dependencies with Service Delivery Leads and Application Owners
* Prepare, maintain, and distribute regular and ad hoc management reports using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik Sense; ensure reports are accurate, timely, and actionable for Global Technology leadership
* Build and maintain workflow automations using Power Automate to streamline recurring reporting, approvals, and notification processes
* Continuously identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting tasks (e.g., via Power Query, SQL, or scripting) to improve turnaround time and reduce manual errors
* Support reporting strategy and process improvement initiatives
* Maintain and update the DR and Ops Management SharePoint site, including documentation, procedures, guidelines, and calendars
* Partner with global technology and operations stakeholders to support infrastructure, database, and desktop management processes
* Create and maintain technical and operational documentation, including implementation notes, process guides, and FAQs
* Work effectively within a team distributed across multiple geographic locations



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* ITIL v3 or ITIL Service Operation knowledge/certification
* Exposure to cloud DR/backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Site Recovery, or equivalent)
* Experience with SharePoint site administration/configuration beyond basic content updates
* Ability to support a 24x7 operational environment, including occasional weekend or off\-hours work as required
* Enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment and learning new tools/technologies

**Job Title:** 
 Specialist, Financial Operations
 


  

  


**Description:** 
 In this role, You'll Drive transformation across Rights \& Royalties operations by leveraging business analysis, data analytics, and workflow automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, controls, and decision\-making. **The Role** 



  

  


 We are seeking a high\-impact Business Analyst / Data Analyst (3–4 years’ experience) to join the Rights \& Royalties Transformation Group. This role blends business analysis, analytics, and workflow automation to improve royalty accuracy, cycle times, controls, and decision visibility. The ideal candidate is fast, agile, and execution\-focused, able to grasp business fundamentals quickly, translate them into data and process requirements, and deliver measurable operational outcomes through dashboards, automation, and standardisation. Royalties domain experience is a strong advantage (rights, licensing, royalty calculations, statements, author/vendor payments, deductions, reserves, contractual terms).

* Understanding of royalty lifecycle (preferred).
  

  
* Basic scripting (Python) or familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts, dbt, or data quality tooling (preferred).
  

  
* Experience with process mapping, Lean basics, or continuous improvement methods (preferred).
  

  
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science / IT / Data Analytics or Finance / Accounting / Commerce.
  

  
* MBA (Operations / Finance / Analytics), PG Diploma in Business Analytics / Data Science, or relevant Data \& Analytics Certifications are differentiators.
  


  


**What You'll Get** 



  

  
* High\-visibility transformation scope with measurable business impact.

 database management.

description:

 Appvanta is an AI\-first product engineering and consulting firm founded in 2026, focused on helping startups, enterprises, and growing organizations build and modernize digital products. Appvanta partners with clients to optimize operations, streamline processes, and drive innovation through technology. Team members work on forward\-looking projects that use AI and modern product practices to solve real\-world business challenges.

 This full\-time remote Junior Business Analyst role involves supporting product and consulting projects by gathering, documenting, and analyzing business requirements.
